result.verdict_scope: ECDLP-IDEA-436's primary named family D1, inv_{j,r}(k) = v_p(x([k]S-hat) - x([j]S-hat)) truncated at precision r, under E/F_p ordinary with good reduction, p >= 3, gcd(n,p) = 1, a Weierstrass model, and the canonical order-n prime-to-p torsion lift.
result.simulation_procedure: One equality test A = B, one group inversion to form -B, one equality test A = -B; return the truncation cap r on either hit and 0 otherwise. Overhead: 1 group operation and 2 equality tests per emitted value, independent of r, n and p. Valid in the STRICT Shoup GGM, not only the structured GGM.
result.why_it_is_simulable: Under the stated hypotheses the functional is two-valued. Reduction is injective on prime-to-p torsion (KN-TECH-73630e), so x([k]S-hat) lies in Z_p and reduces to x([k]S); and on a Weierstrass model the x-map has exactly the plus-or-minus fibres, so the difference has positive valuation only when x([k]S) = x([j]S), in which case [k]S-hat = plus-or-minus [j]S-hat and the difference is exactly zero. Hence the value is 0 or plus-infinity and never finite-and-positive, and the separating predicate is the group-theoretic predicate k congruent to plus-or-minus j mod n. Precision r is inert.
result.relation_to_existing_closure: Same closure mechanism as KN-FIND-b7e091's endomorphism oracle (collapse to a group-theoretic computation), and strictly stronger than KN-FIND-002's jet closure, which holds only in the structured GGM that KN-FIND-002 itself discloses as a weakening.
result.residue_not_closed: ECDLP-IDEA-436's secondary disjunct D2 -- a fixed statistic of the precision-r coordinate digits of a SINGLE lifted point -- does NOT collapse and is closed only RELATIVELY (structured GGM, zero group-operation overhead, no advantage over an adversary already holding F_p coordinates). The nearby-object control shows a relative closure of that shape cannot be promoted to an absolute exponent-1/2 statement, since the same move would falsely close anomalous-curve ECDLP.
result.recommendation_to_coordinator: Scoped rejection of ECDLP-IDEA-436 as written, per that record's own gate and disproof-track language. This is a recommendation only; the status change is the Coordinator's authority and this task made none.
